name: Story Island Decorations
author: Run'nGun
description: Adds some of the decorative items from Story Islands to your Raft. This mod is a work in progress, and more items will be added over time.

modSettings.name: easelGenericWallQuad
modSettings.text: Allow any wall item on easel
tooltip: When enabled, the easel painting socket uses the vanilla Quad_Wall.
This allows any wall item to be placed on the easel.
Note: This may look weird with some items as generic wall items have not been ligned up for easel
